newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB to buyback up to 89.25 mln shrs. [CORRECTED 02:34 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB to buyback up to 89.25 mln shrs. [CORRECTED 02:34 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects amount of shares to bought back in the headline and the first paragraph from 98.25 million shares.)
National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Monday it planned to buyback up to 89.25 million shares, which is about 5.97 percent of its issued share capital.
NAB said the buy-back starts on April 8 and would end on October 7, 1997. It said the buy-back would optimise delivery of value to shareholders.
It said brokers J.B. Were & Son and Merrill Lynch Equities (Australia) would act as brokers to the buy-back.
At 1.20 p.m. (0220 GMT), NAB shares were 39 cents up or 2.51 percent up at A$15.90.
